dataset_description: Short collaborator-facing summary of what this dataset represents and why it is useful.
labeling_policy: Brief note about who labeled the reports, how disagreements were resolved, and what safety constraints apply.
notes: Optional submission note carried into the generated draft.
notable_strengths: Replace this with a real dataset-specific strength before sharing the generated submission.
known_limitations: Replace this with a real dataset-specific limitation before sharing the generated submission.

cohort_descriptions.description: Use short human-readable cohort names so the generated casebook can publish coverage and context together.

benchmark_bucket_descriptions.description: Optional description that explains why this benchmark slice matters to reviewers.
